title: Game Developer
description: A beginner-to-portfolio roadmap for game programming, engines, gameplay systems, art/audio pipeline, testing, and publishing.

tree.name: Programming and Game Math
tree.description: Learn enough code and math to move objects, simulate rules, and reason about game loops.

children.name: C# or GDScript Basics
children.description: Use variables, functions, classes, events, collections, and debugging inside a game project.

children.name: Vectors, Collision, and Movement
children.description: Understand coordinates, vectors, delta time, physics basics, collision, and cameras.

tree.name: Choose an Engine
tree.description: Pick one primary engine, then learn scenes, assets, input, UI, physics, animation, and builds.

resources.title: Godot Game Development Crash Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Godot Path
children.description: Use nodes, scenes, signals, scripts, resources, physics, UI, and exports.

resources.title: Godot Tutorial for Unity Developers and Beginners (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Unity Path
children.description: Use GameObjects, components, prefabs, scenes, input, physics, and C# scripts.

children.name: Practice: Game Feel Polish Pass
children.description: Improve controls, feedback, animation, audio, difficulty, and onboarding for a tiny playable prototype.

tree.name: Gameplay Systems
tree.description: Build the systems players notice: controls, enemies, levels, saves, menus, audio, and feedback.

children.name: AI and Level Design
children.description: Create enemy states, pathfinding basics, difficulty curves, level flow, and encounter design.

children.name: Game UI and Audio
children.description: Add menus, HUD, pause, accessibility options, sound effects, music, and polish.

tree.name: Testing and Publishing
tree.description: Playtest, optimize, package builds, create store pages, and publish small finished games.

children.name: Playtesting and Performance
children.description: Collect feedback, fix bugs, measure frame rate, reduce build size, and improve onboarding.

children.name: Store Page and Community Feedback
children.description: Create trailers, screenshots, itch.io/Steam pages, feedback forms, devlogs, and release checklists.

children.name: Project: Publish a Small Game
children.description: Finish a polished 2D game with menus, saves, sound, tutorial, builds, screenshots, and a store page.
